text:
rajiv: paging on-call — high error spike for Dedicated EU cluster routing (eu-west-1). Customers using reserved pools seeing 502/timeout. I'm triaging, creating thread. incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-042 created, severity: P1 (customer-impacting).

incident-bot: Notifying ops channel and on-call. Statuspage draft: 
```
We are investigating an issue impacting inference requests routed through our Dedicated EU cluster (eu-west-1). Some enterprise customers may experience increased errors and elevated latency. Our engineers are actively investigating and will provide updates shortly.```

marta: thanks. Rajiv — can you paste the k8s pod error logs and which service is failing?

rajiv: logs from router pod (truncated):
```
2026-03-15T09:23:12Z router INFO incoming request from 10.2.5.14
2026-03-15T09:23:13Z router WARN upstream timeout to ded-gpu-02: rpc deadline exceeded
2026-03-15T09:23:14Z router ERROR 502 unable to reach backend: connection refused
```
Routing service showing sudden connection refusals to a subset of dedicated instances. CPU on the GPU hosts looks normal. Network errors spike to those hosts.

marta: starting a targeted probe to the dedicated pool host set. rajiv — please collect netstat and dmesg from the affected hosts: ded-gpu-02, ded-gpu-03.

rajiv: grabbing netstat/dmesg now. Also seeing a flurry of retries from a small set of enterprise API keys — looks like heavy retry loops from a handful of customers hitting batch endpoints.

elaine: which customers are impacted? AcmeCorp just pinged my line — they reported timeouts on their nightly job.

dimitri: we have a few enterprise accounts routing to eu-west-1 reserved: AcmeCorp, Zephyr Analytics, NorthStar Health. I'll add contact matrix below with preferred contact method (for the comms team).

--- affected accounts & routing contact (for internal ops use) ---
AcmeCorp | AE: elaine | escalation: pager (Elaine) -> CS (Dimitri) | preferred notice: email + MSTEAMS
Zephyr Analytics | AE: tom (not on thread) | escalation: CS -> account engineering | preferred notice: email
NorthStar Health | AE: marta-handoff | escalation: enterprise-support -> security (HIPAA) | preferred notice: phone + email

marta: good. We need tailored impact lines per account for customer notifications. Drafts below; keep short and prescriptive.

elaine: I'll send AcmeCorp this variant after we confirm mitigation window. Draft: "We're investigating timeouts affecting inference requests routed to eu-west-1 reserved capacity. Our mitigation is focused on rerouting traffic and stabilizing dedicated instances. We'll follow up with ETA and workaround; for immediate needs, you can toggle to hosted API or move traffic to us-east-1. (AE: elaine)"

rajiv: operational mitigation in progress: 1) temporarily mark faulty dedicated nodes out of routing pool; 2) enable fallback route policy for enterprise customers to compatible dedicated variants in eu-central-1 or hosted fallback; 3) cancel aggressive client retries via rate-limit rule for the affected API keys.

ops-bot: Rollout action queued: remove instances ded-gpu-02,ded-gpu-03 from router pool -> started.

marta: rajiv — once we remove nodes, can you confirm per-customer traffic shift and error rate delta? We'll need that to populate the status page update and customer emails.

rajiv: will post metrics in 10 mins. Preliminary: error rate for AcmeCorp dropped from 18% -> 3% after routing half their traffic to eu-central-1. Latency neutral.

dimitri: based on that, here's a suggested short email for AcmeCorp (AE tweaks allowed):
Subject: Temporary impact to inference requests (eu-west-1)
Body:
"Hi <AE/Customer>,
We are currently investigating an issue affecting inference requests routed to our Dedicated EU cluster (eu-west-1). You may experience intermittent timeouts and elevated error rates for jobs scheduled during the incident window.

What we're doing: we've isolated affected nodes and are rerouting your traffic to alternate capacity to restore service.
Action for you: if you need immediate full throughput, you can switch to the hosted API region (us-east-1) or delay non-urgent jobs for ~30-45 minutes while we stabilize.
We will update you again within 30 minutes with a mitigation status and ETA.

Sincerely,
Redwood Inference Operations"

marta: fine-grain tweak: add explicit note about data handling (enterprise customers care): "No data leakage — requests are still processed within Redwood's infrastructure and adherence to customer data controls remains in effect."

elaine: sending now to AcmeCorp via Teams. I'll include the AE triage phone number for urgent escalation.

rajiv: nets stats: ded-gpu-02 had transient NIC errors in dmesg — "mlx5_core: port 1 link down" — looks like intermittent IB fabric flaps. We're engaging infra to check switch side.

marta: escalate to infra network on-call. Also prepare the public status page update using this short blurb (customer-facing):
```
Incident: Dedicated EU routing errors (eu-west-1)
Status: Investigating
Impact: Some customers using Dedicated EU cluster may experience timeouts and elevated error rates for inference requests. We are isolating affected nodes and routing traffic to alternate capacity.```

incident-bot: Statuspage update queued (Investigating).

dimitri: internal comms template for AEs (paste into CR):
"Customer: <name> | Impact: inference timeouts for jobs routed to eu-west-1 | Mitigation: traffic rerouted, nodes quarantined | ETA: next update in 30 mins | AE actions: inform customer of fallback options; offer assisted region switch if needed."

marta: handoff plan — if this continues beyond 1 hour, escalate to P1 war room and invite infra-network, product (dedicated lead), and legal (for HIPAA customers). I'll take 2nd hour on-call; rajiv you stay primary until handoff at +30.

rajiv: acknowledged. Will post the 10-min metrics snapshot and cross-post to incidents channel.

elaine: AcmeCorp acknowledged, reduced job concurrency on their side; they prefer fallback to eu-central-1 rather than hosted for data locality. I'll coordinate the cutover.

ops-bot: Automated note: reroute completed for AcmeCorp -> eu-central-1 (partial).

marta: thanks team. Keep updates short — next update at +30m or on-change. If error rates climb after mitigation, call the war room. :thumbsup:

(END THREAD)
